message:
Let me try a different approach. Let me look at the git history of the HTMLparser.c file around the time of this vulnerability. The OSS-Fuzz issue ID 4953329095802880 would be from around 2023 (when libxml2 2.11.0 was current). Let me search for the fix.

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>curl -sL "https://api.github.com/repos/GNOME/libxml2/commits?path=HTMLparser.c&per_page=100" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
for item in data:
    sha = item['sha'][:10]
    msg = item['commit']['message'].split('\n')[0][:100]
    date = item['commit']['author']['date'][:10]
    print(f'{date} {sha} {msg}')
" 2>/dev/null | head -50</｜｜DSML｜｜ode>
